acl.explain.allow: Connections from {src} to {dst} are explicitly allowed {proto}.
acl.explain.unknown_action: The action of this rule could not be determined, so its effect on traffic from {src} to {dst} is unknown.
acl.explain.disabled: This rule is currently disabled and has no effect.

matrix.default_wan_in: Unsolicited connections from the Internet are blocked by the gateway by default.

matrix.guest: Guest network isolation blocks guest clients from reaching private networks.
